Level 6 · Lead Architect Practice

Level 6: Lead Architect Practice

Lead architecture across an organisation: strategy, roadmap, stakeholders and teams, including the AI agents that now work beside them.

See pathways

Planned: outline published, course not built

Who it is for
Senior architects and heads of engineering who set architecture direction for an organisation.
Before you start
Level 5, Architecture Governance and Evolution, or equivalent experience leading architecture work.
Capstone evidence
An architecture strategy document, presented and defended against hard questions.
How it is assessed
Planned: a portfolio, an oral defence and independent review. A multiple-choice test alone cannot assess this level, so none will be used for it.

Modules and evidence

Each module ends in an artefact that goes into your record.

ModuleWhat it coversEvidence
Architecture as leadershipInfluence, communication and money.Stakeholder map, business case and a roadmap a board can read in ten minutes
The organisationWhere architecture meets structure.Capability map and build, buy or partner decisions
PracticeApply it and defend it.An architecture strategy you present and defend
